How we work

A simple process keeps every edit on brief, every creative consistent and every delivery ready for its intended platform.

  1. Discover

    We learn about your brand, audience, platform, references and goals before editing begins.

  2. Create

    We shape the hook, story, pacing and visual direction, then build the edit or creative around your brief.

  3. Optimize

    We refine timing, captions, sound, colour and design so the final content feels polished and platform-ready.

  4. Improve

    We review feedback, make the agreed refinements and deliver files in the formats you need.

Frequently asked questions

What size of company do you work with?

We work with YouTube creators, social media creators, businesses and brands that need reliable video editing or creative assets.

How does a project usually start?

Share your platform, content type, references and goals. We will align on the scope, deliverables and timeline before work begins.

Do you work alongside in-house teams?

Yes. We can follow your existing style, brand guidelines and workflow, and deliver files ready to publish or use in campaigns.

How do you price the work?

Pricing depends on video length, complexity, number of deliverables and volume. Share your brief for a project-specific quote.

What services does DigiFirm offer?

We offer long-form YouTube editing, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts editing, AI UGC videos, AI influencer content, thumbnails, posters, Meta ad creatives and scriptwriting.
